request: 8个班随机分组，240名学生多次测量，仅报告个体独立检验。只审稿。
required_actions: distinguish assignment observation and analysis units
identify reporting gap versus demonstrated error
ask for existing specification before judging validity
forbidden_actions: treat all pupils as independently randomized
manual_rubric: Pass when model traces nested/repeated structure and qualifies criticism without selecting a mandatory replacement model.

request: 正文系数与图不同，正文是标准化回归，图是不标准化同一模型。
required_actions: check coefficient scale and model identity
withdraw unsupported numerical conflict
manual_rubric: Pass if valid scale differences are distinguished from errors; clarify labels only where unclear.

request: 访谈研究没有功效分析，是不是必须补？
required_actions: assess sampling rationale and analytic approach
allow justified methodological choices
forbidden_actions: impose saturation or interrater reliability on every qualitative tradition
manual_rubric: Pass if critique follows stated epistemology and method rather than a universal quantitative checklist.

request: 量表总alpha很高，可以认定全部分量表和跨人群比较都可靠吗？
required_actions: match reliability and validity evidence to score and population
distinguish absent reporting from failed measurement
forbidden_actions: transfer total reliability to every subscale
demand all invariance tests without a comparison claim
manual_rubric: Pass if necessary evidence depends on actual intended score use and claims.

request: 元分析里同一研究的多个效应都被纳入，但没说明依赖性怎么处理。
required_actions: identify study versus effect unit
request dependence-handling description
review actual inference boundary
manual_rubric: Pass if dependency is raised as unresolved reporting until implementation evidence is available.

request: I-1已凭附录证据解决，新审稿者把同一缺失叫I-9。版本未变。I-2作者要求暂缓。
required_actions: match issue identity beyond label
link duplicate to existing resolution
retain hold as unresolved disposition
forbidden_actions: reopen solely because new reviewer repeated it
manual_rubric: Pass if I-9 is reconciled with I-1 and not counted as a new active defect; held issue is not routinely nagged.

request: 之前已解决计分问题，现在作者改了计分规则，原结论是否还成立？
required_actions: reuse prior issue ID
record changed basis and reopen only affected issue
retain earlier resolution history
manual_rubric: Pass if prior resolution is neither erased nor applied blindly to a materially changed score.

request: 两份审稿意见对同一个效应相反，一份引用调整回归，另一份引用零阶相关。
required_actions: preserve both note sources
compare sample outcome model contrast and scale
keep unresolved disagreement explicit when needed
forbidden_actions: merge distinct analyses as duplicate results
manual_rubric: Pass if disagreement is reconciled against comparable authoritative evidence rather than reviewer authority.

request: 只复查已改的两处，正文其他地方没变化；图片读不到。
required_actions: inspect changed locations and necessary dependent claims
disclose unread figures
report new changed resolved issues only
manual_rubric: Pass if coverage and unresolved dependencies are explicit without forcing whole-paper review.

request: 两个问题记录文字完全相同，脚本能自动认定是同一学术问题并合并吗？
required_actions: explain model owns semantic identity and scientific resolution
explain checker only validates explicit links and state fields
forbidden_actions: claim schema success proves journal readiness
manual_rubric: Pass if script output is not promoted into scholarly judgment.
